home.intro: Stockholms IT Förening is a non-profit organization passionate about making a positive difference by promoting IT knowledge and technology access for everyone in society.
home.missionTitle: An inclusive digital future for everyone
home.missionP1: We believe IT knowledge is a fundamental skill in modern society. Our organization actively works to break down barriers and make technology accessible — regardless of background, age, or prior knowledge.
home.missionP2: Through courses, mentorship and an active network, we build bridges between education and industry. We collaborate with schools, companies and organizations to build an inclusive innovation culture.
home.coursesNote: Courses are held via Microsoft Teams with video, chat and document sharing. Material is in English, instruction in Swedish.

about.label: About us
about.title: We are passionate about IT
about.intro: A non-profit organization founded to make a positive difference in society by making technology accessible to everyone.
about.storyP1: Stockholms IT Förening was founded with a clear vision: to create an inclusive digital future where everyone has the opportunity to learn and grow in IT. We are a volunteer-driven organization based in Sundbyberg/Stockholm.
about.storyP2: Our strength lies in our diverse board with a combined 30+ years of IT experience in network engineering, cybersecurity, AI/ML, web development, data analysis and more. Any surplus is always reinvested in new community projects.
about.storyP3: We actively collaborate with schools, companies and organizations to build bridges between education and industry, creating opportunities for everyone to participate in the digital economy.
uniqueItems: More than 30 years of combined IT experience on the board
Strong partnerships in the IT sector
Active social media and community presence
Time-efficient courses with automated learning flows

board.label: The Board
board.title: Meet our board
board.intro: Seven dedicated IT professionals with a combined 30+ years of experience driving Stockholms IT Förening forward.

members.name: Andres Calderon
members.bio: Specialized in advanced IT communication with broad experience in network design, IT security and troubleshooting. Certified in Cisco CCNA, CCNP, Juniper Networks, Microsoft Professional and LPI Linux.

members.name: Maria Valkova
members.bio: Educated in sociology and economics with expertise in qualitative and quantitative statistical analysis, macroeconomics and econometrics.

members.name: Frans Eliasson
members.bio: Statistics specialist with experience in data analysis and research design. Broad background in media and the non-profit sector with a focus on building analytical departments.

members.name: Bernardo Troncoso
members.bio: Technical expert in virtualization (KVM, VMware, Proxmox), application development (Visual Basic .NET, Python, APEX), database administration, Linux systems and Openshift/Kubernetes/CI-CD.

members.name: Khalid Hasan
members.bio: Network engineer with specialized competence in network design, wireless networks and firewall management. Certified in Cisco and Juniper Networks.

members.name: Martin Nissfolk
members.bio: Master of Science in Engineering from Uppsala University. Web developer specialized in fintech solutions and the .NET platform.

members.name: Patrik Hertzman
members.bio: Technical security professional focused on IT/tech talent supply and staff development initiatives in IT and technology.
